title: USCIS Releases New Immigrant Investor Form
paragraphs: We have publishedForm I-956K, Registration for Direct and Third-Party Promoters. TheEB-5 Reform and Integrity Act of 2022added the requirement for direct and third-party promoters to register with USCIS.
Each person acting as a direct or third-party promoter (including migration agents) of the following must complete Form I-956K:
There is no filing fee for Form I-956K.
For more information, please see ourEB-5 Immigrant Investor Programpage.
